setupInstructions.step1: Set organization.name to your client's legal entity name.
setupInstructions.step2: Review goals — adjust targets to match the client's Year 1 ambitions.
setupInstructions.step5: Invite the client admin at /admin/users, then run ENTERPRISE_COACH.

goals.label: Annual Revenue
goals.notes: Top-line revenue target. Tracked against invoices issued and collected.

goals.label: Project Margin
goals.notes: Average gross margin across all active projects. Tracked against budget vs actuals.

goals.label: Client NPS
goals.notes: Net Promoter Score from quarterly client feedback surveys.

goals.label: Delivery SLA Adherence
goals.notes: Percentage of milestones delivered on or before due date. Tracked per project by PROJECT_HEALTH agent.

goals.label: Employee Utilization
goals.notes: Billable hours as percentage of available hours. Tracked against task assignments.

entityTypes.name: Milestone

entityTypes.name: Invoice

entityTypes.name: Lead

entityTypes.name: Proposal

entityTypes.name: Resource

entityTypes.name: ChangeRequest

policies.name: Block record deletion
policies.description: WAANDA may never delete records — only archive. Immutable audit trail.

policies.name: Block unauthorised external writes
policies.description: Any EXTERNAL_API_CALL must pass L3 approval before proceeding.

policies.name: Notify on critical risk
policies.description: CRITICAL severity risks must trigger an immediate internal notification.

policies.name: Require approval for large invoices
policies.description: Invoices above ₹5 lakh require L3 approval before issue.

policies.name: Notify on low-quality lead advance
policies.description: Alert if a lead with score < 30 advances to PROPOSAL stage.

delivery.name: Project Kick-off
delivery.description: Triggered on new project creation. Briefs WAANDA, sets goals, creates milestone plan, assigns risks, notifies client.

delivery.name: Milestone Review
delivery.description: 7-day pre-milestone health check. Routes to internal flag or client update based on project status.

delivery.name: Risk Escalation
delivery.description: CRITICAL risk triggers blast-radius assessment, L3 approval, then client notification.

delivery.name: Project Closure
delivery.description: All deliverables complete. Quality check → client sign-off → COIG checkpoint → lessons learned.

finance.name: Invoice Approval
finance.description: Invoice created above threshold. WAANDA validates → L3 approval → status update.

finance.name: Collections Escalation
finance.description: 14-day overdue invoice. WAANDA drafts collections message → L2 approval → send.

finance.name: Budget Variance Alert
finance.description: Weekly actuals vs plan scan. Routes by severity: log / internal alert / decision proposal.

sales.name: Lead Qualification Flow
sales.description: New lead. DEAL_COACH scores → proposes accept/nurture/decline → creates tasks on qualification.

sales.name: Proposal Follow-up
sales.description: 5-day no-response trigger. DEAL_COACH drafts follow-up — auto-send < ₹5L, L2 review ≥ ₹5L.

L2.label: Managed
L2.description: Core workflows running, WAANDA making proposals.

L3.label: Optimised
L3.description: Delivery and finance on WAANDA. Coach insights surfacing.

L4.label: Predictive
L4.description: Digital Twin active. COIG tracked. Customer Zero Report generated.

L5.label: Adaptive
L5.description: Enterprise continuously improves. Pack extracted and reusable.

G1_ContextAssembly.rationale: Context must accurately reflect project, finance, and pipeline data.

G2_DecisionQuality.rationale: WAANDA decisions must be traceable to evidence before L3 approval.

G3_PlanningAccuracy.rationale: Workflow plans must match execution within acceptable variance.

G4_ExecutionReliability.rationale: Approved workflows must complete without failure >85% of the time.

G5_WorkflowCanvas.rationale: Canvas must render all 9 seeded workflows correctly.

G6_RealTimeIntelligence.rationale: Signals must surface within 60s of triggering events.

G7_ReleaseGovernance.rationale: All deployments must pass RGS pre-flight before production.

G8_OIS.rationale: Minimum OIS of 60/100 before Customer Zero Report is considered credible.

dnaProfile.notes: approvalSpeed starts MODERATE for most PS firms — L3 approvals average 4–8 hours. After 90 days on WAANDA, firms with healthy COIG typically shift to FAST (< 2h median).

rgsRules: No workflow changes to ACTIVE workflows without RGS pre-flight check.
OIS must not decline more than 5 points within any 7-day window without a CHECKPOINT snapshot saved.
CRITICAL risks created by WAANDA agents must be acknowledged within 24 hours.
L3 approval queue must not accumulate more than 10 pending items — flag to admin if exceeded.
Enterprise DNA must be recomputed at least once every 30 days.
COIG baseline must be set before any COIG numbers are communicated externally.
